name: practical-agent-skills
description: Engineering pipeline for coding agents that routes work by size: small fixes go straight to a TDD implementer, medium work gets a task file, implementation and one review, large work runs proposal, breakdown, implementation batches, parallel reviews and specs. Resumable state in .temp/<topic>/, explicit gates only at commits, design choices, review findings and manual checks, and git safety hooks.
suggestedPrompts: /flow Where did I leave off, and what is the next step?
/flow Add the change I describe and take it all the way to a commit
/shape Help me turn a raw idea into a clear goal with success criteria
/audit Audit this repository and rank what to fix first
